messages:
Aisha: Vendor notice received — H100 list price in us-east increasing ~18% effective 2026-05-01. Need a quick impact triage on unit economics for Hosted and Dedicated.
fin-bot: Automated alert: projected cloud spend +12% next quarter if consumption unchanged. Preview: https://billing.company/forecast/2026-05
Marco: Quick back-of-envelope for typical inference profile (seq=384, batch=1). GPU-only delta: pre $2.60/hr -> post $3.07/hr -> tokens/hr ~7.0M; cost/token 0.000371 -> 0.000438 (~18% increase). That alone pressures Hosted gross margin by ~3.8 percentage points if we hold prices.
Priya: Product levers to consider: (A) modest hosted list increase, (B) new multi-year "price-protected" commit product, (C) tweak burst pricing bands or introduce an "economy" routing tier. Prefer options B/C short-term to avoid headline price change.
Carlos: Region note: eu-central reserved H100 pricing is ~5-7% lower on our rate card. But moving inference across regions incurs egress + KV replication cost and latency risk. Need routing sims.
Aisha: Immediate asks:
- Marco: model-by-model per-token delta for top-12 models by spend, include seq=128 and seq=512 amortized rows and Dedicated amortization scenario. ETA 8h.
- Carlos: routing simulation to estimate what percent of Hosted traffic we can safely re-route to eu-central without violating SLOs; include egress $/token and latency delta. ETA 36h.
- Priya + RevOps: churn sensitivity and ARR impact for changes limited to new signups vs all customers; also forecast uptake if we offer 12/24-month protected commits. ETA 72h.
billing-bot: Reminder: several Dedicated reserve discounts expire Q3; list in drive: https://drive.company/dedicated/expiring_list
Marco: Example CSV snippet I'll produce:
```
model,seq,baseline_gpu_per_token,post_gpu_per_token,post_total_per_token,delta_pct
redwood-3b,128,0.00018,0.00021,0.00025,17.1
redwood-7b,512,0.00031,0.00037,0.00044,19.4
```
Marco: I'll also attach per-customer impact for top 20 accounts by spend so we can prioritize outreach where margin turns negative under current pricing.
Carlos: Early sim notes: ~22% of Hosted traffic appears routable to eu-central with acceptable median latency increase for batch workloads; real-time chat traffic looks <5% routable. Cross-region KV adds an egress cost ~0.015c/token in worst-case sync patterns.
Priya: Short-term mitigation thought: offer accelerated Dedicated commit discounts (short-term cash outflow) to lock customers at today's effective unit price and smooth revenue while supply-side prices normalize.
Aisha: Proposed timetable: Marco model CSV + summary (8h), Carlos routing sim + perf logs (36h), Finance/RevOps churn + margin sensitivity (72h). Exec recommendation by end of week.
Marco: Uploading assets to /finance/h100-impact and will ping when ready. :arrow_up_small:
Carlos: I'll start a small routing canary (2% traffic) to eu-central after baseline perf capture. Will post results to #eng-infra.
Priya: Drafting comms for three outcomes (absorb cost, partial pass-through, commit promotion) and a brief FAQ for Sales.
Aisha: Thanks — if anyone sees critical customers that need immediate outreach, add them to the shared sheet. Scheduling a 30m leadership sync Friday after initial artifacts are in. :eyes:
